source_hash_policy: SHA256 of CSV bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization for cross-platform checkouts
inspection_history: unknown; confirmed by group member on 2026-11-23
limitation: Historical raw-data inspection and dictionary design may involve any respondent. Grouped evaluation does not remove historical feature-selection exposure.
assignment_algorithm: Python random.Random(seed) shuffles sorted integer IDs; fold = shuffled position modulo fold count. Inner seed = 1067 + outer fold.
eda_training_rule: outer_fold != 0; 232 respondents / 696 rows for the supplied dataset
evaluation_rule: Nested grouped development CV: tune within each outer training partition using its recorded three inner folds; evaluate only the selected setting on that outer validation fold. Retrospective evidence, not an untouched test estimate.
